preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in input)
preconditions.description: Each input name is a string.
Each input name contains at least one word.
Each input name contains at least one hyphen/dash, which is treated as a space.

postconditions.description: The number of output codes is the same as the number of input names.
Each output code is in upper case.
Each output code is exactly four letters long.

postconditions.expression: all(code == create_code(name) for code, name in zip(output, input))
postconditions.description: Each output code is created according to the rules based on the corresponding input name.
